item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello! It's the weekend. No school today! It's Sunday, November 1. Time for the weather! It's Sunday, a good day to rest and get ready for the week. In Shanghai today, expect it to be rainy on and off. The high will be 27 degrees, and the low will be 16 degrees. Pleasantly warm today, perfect for being outdoors. Rain is about 92 percent likely today. The sun goes down at 5:05 this evening, about 2 minutes earlier than yesterday. Can you feel the days getting shorter? Remember to take an umbrella with you! Looking ahead to tomorrow, it will be grey and rainy, reaching 20 degrees. Something to think about: what is your favourite kind of weather, and why? And that's it for today's weather. Have a lovely time!
